newsitem.title: USA: Starcraft to close plant, take Q3 writeoff.
newsitem.headline: Starcraft to close plant, take Q3 writeoff.

text.p: Starcraft Corp said Tuesday it will close its McGregor, Texas plant and take a pretax writeoff of $260,000 in the third quarter to cover the costs of shutting down the facility.

Starcraft said it has sold certain assets of the McGregor plant and will consolidate the continuing operations into its Goshen, Indiana facility. The Texas operation at one point had 100 employees, but the company said it will not relocate any of them to Indiana.
Starcraft manufactures van, sport utility vehicle and truck conversions.

"We continue to reduce excess production capacity and streamline our operations to bring our costs in line with the industry's current soft market conditions," Michael Schoeffler, president of Starcraft, said in a statement.
"At the same time, we believe that the strategic moves we have made over the past year have positioned the company to take advantage of the rebound in our markets as they occur," he said.
